subject.title: RFC 0009: align Hosted Feed v1 specifications

question: Should OpenClaw standardize the full publisher-first Hosted Feed v1 distribution and DSSE trust contract in this RFC before the linked OpenClaw and ClawHub implementation proposals land?
rationale: The diff establishes new normative cross-repository protocol and trust commitments; neither documentation review nor automated repair can determine the intended long-term API and trust boundary.

options.title: Approve after interoperability proof
options.body: Confirm the publisher-first contract as the durable shared direction after reviewing a redacted final-head OpenClaw–ClawHub validation transcript.

options.title: Narrow the initial standard
options.body: Approve only the stable core snapshot and trust contract, deferring query, delta, or follow-discovery rules until their implementations are reviewed.

recommendation.title: Approve after interoperability proof
recommendation.body: Confirm the publisher-first contract as the durable shared direction after reviewing a redacted final-head OpenClaw–ClawHub validation transcript.
